热交换器清洁与维护
Some machines use other cooler cores (radiators) to lower the temperature of transmission oil, hydraulic oil or air conditioning refrigerant. In most cases, the cores are upstream of the air flow to the radiator to get the coolest air. The additional cores increase the temperature of the air that passes through the radiator as well as increase the resistance to air flow. The additional cores also make it more difficult to thoroughly clean the radiator core. Recent design changes on some machines allow these additional cores to be easily swung to the side to allow better access to clean the radiator core. Cooling System Temperature Cooling systems are designed to keep an engine operating within a desired temperature range. The temperature of the coolant must remain high to allow the engine to operate efficiently.

Eventually, a pit can become deep enough to break through the cylinder wall and allow coolant to leak into the cylinder. This coolant leak contaminates the lubricating oil. Supplemental coolant additives coat metal surfaces and control cavitation-erosion and pitting. Unfortunately, small particles or ferrous scale often shield the surfaces underneath from the protective action of coolant additives. If this condition persists, pits can form. Keeping your cooling system clean, along with regularly replenishing your coolant additives, helps prevent pitting. However, if coolant additives are not added at the proper intervals and in correct quantities (see page 24), cavitation erosion and pitting intensifies. Eventually, coolant can penetrate the cylinder wall and cause major damage to the engine.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

candidate_results.text:
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

candidate_results.text:
冷却水系统设备（泵）：轴向间隙 ≥ 1.5 × 泵壳长度，用于叶轮/轴拆卸；径向间隙 ≥ 轴直径 + 100 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（板式换热器/管束）：全板束/管束抽出长度在一侧。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（阀手轮/执行器）：操作侧间隙 ≥ 600 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统通道：最小净宽度 ≥ 600 mm，人员通过处；≥ 500 mm，仅检查处。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（移除质量 > 25 kg）：应设置顶部吊装设施（吊眼或单轨）。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（需定期维护）：应具有清晰的铭牌，标明维护间隔和标签号。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。

MAN B&W Two-Stroke Engine HT (High-Temperature) Jacket Water Temperature Specifications:
- Jacket water outlet temperature (after engine), normal operating range: 75–85°C
- Thermostat control target (Valve A - max): maintains jacket water outlet T < 80°C
- Thermostat control target (Valve B - min): maintains jacket water outlet T > 75°C
- Jacket water inlet temperature (before engine): typically 65–75°C (≈ outlet – 10°C)
- Standby pre-heating setpoint (hot engine on standby): 80–85°C
- Minimum jacket water temperature before loading to >80% SMCR: 50°C
- Normal pre-heating maintenance temperature: 60–80°C (pre-heater keeps engine warm)
These values apply to standard central cooling configurations. The thermostatic valve must maintain a constant 80°C at engine outlet regardless of seawater temperature.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

candidate_results.text:
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

Treated coolant can become contaminated during operation and the additive can lose some of its effectiveness. It is therefore advisable to check the cool- ing system and the condition of the coolant regularly. To detect leaks in the lubricating oil system, regular checking of the water in the expansion tank is recommended. Signs of oil in the water include discoloration or a visible oil film on the surface of the water sample. Check the additive concentration using the test kits provided by the additive manufacturer at least once per week. The results must be recorded. Note: The chemical additive concentrations shall not be less than the minimum con- centrations specified. See paragraph Permitted coolant additives, Page 272. Excessively low concentrations lead to corrosion and must be avoided. Con- centrations that are somewhat higher do not cause damage.

designed so that no continuous electrical potential is imposed upon any cooling system components. Despite coolant mixture quality, the presence of an electrical potential can cause materials in the cooling system to be damaged by electrolytic corrosion. Soundness of ground connections should be checked with a volt/ohm meter. Typically, measured resistance between an electrical component on the engine and battery negative should be less than 0.3 ohms. All grounds should be tight and free of corrosion. Aluminum material parts are susceptible to electrolytic corrosion. Aluminum requires only about one-half the electrical potential as iron to produce the same damaging effect. With the aluminum components of newer engines, greater care is required to ensure proper grounding to prevent electrical potential differences.

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

Typically, measured resistance between an electrical component on the engine and battery negative should be less than 0.3 ohms. All grounds should be tight and free of corrosion. Aluminum material parts are susceptible to electrolytic corrosion. Aluminum requires only about one-half the electrical potential as iron to produce the same damaging effect. With the aluminum components of newer engines, greater care is required to ensure proper grounding to prevent electrical potential differences.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

E-HT-COMP-005 高温冷却水系统组成
Additional HT preheating arrangement Charge air preheater arrangement for stand-alone dual fuel engines In some few cases issues of misfiring and related smoke emission have been observed during cold start. It has been found that the observed start issue is related to the general lower preheating level of the engine room in case of stand-alone engines. To prevent the cold start issues at stand-alone dual fuel engines it is recom- mended to install an external preheater with circulation pump. The preheater arrangement will support the cold start abilities by circulating preheated water through the charge air cooler before engine start. The external preheater unit with pump is to be installed in addition to the cool- ing water preheating arrangement built into the outlet pipe for the HT cooling water on the engine's front end.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

candidate_results.text:
冷却水系统设备（泵）：轴向间隙 ≥ 1.5 × 泵壳长度，用于叶轮/轴拆卸；径向间隙 ≥ 轴直径 + 100 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（板式换热器/管束）：全板束/管束抽出长度在一侧。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（阀手轮/执行器）：操作侧间隙 ≥ 600 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统通道：最小净宽度 ≥ 600 mm，人员通过处；≥ 500 mm，仅检查处。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（移除质量 > 25 kg）：应设置顶部吊装设施（吊眼或单轨）。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（需定期维护）：应具有清晰的铭牌，标明维护间隔和标签号。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。

candidate_results.text:
高温冷却水管路：表面温度 > 60°C；绝热后表面温度 < 55°C。适用条件：HT回路典型温度 70–95°C，环境温度 25°C，典型船级社要求。
高温冷却水管路、阀门及设备：绝热材料最高工作温度 ≥ 150°C；绝热材料为矿物棉（岩棉/玻璃棉）或等效材料；机械防护包覆材料为铝或不锈钢包覆层。适用条件：暴露于溅水或人员通行的区域。
高温冷却水管路法兰、阀门、仪表连接件及需定期检查的部件：不得施加固定绝热层；应配备可拆卸绝热罩。
无法完全绝热的高温表面（如阀盖、泵壳）：应张贴符合ISO 11684的“热表面”警告标识；标识间距 ≤ 2 m。适用条件：可触及区域。
冷却水管路：按ISO 14726（或船厂特定标准）进行色标标识；HT冷却水为绿色加字母代码；海水为绿色加特定条纹；淡水为绿色。
主要冷却系统设备：应配备铭牌，包含标签号、系统名称及维护间隔。

metadata.normalized_summary: 高温冷却水管路（70–95°C）须绝热使表面<55°C；绝热材料耐温≥150°C+铝皮护套；不能绝热的高温表面须贴ISO 11684热警示标识（间距≤2m）；管路按ISO 14726色标标识。

reasons: 来源为规则或标准，工程权重较高。

constraint.适用对象: 高温冷却水管路（包括管道、阀门、设备）
constraint.核心要求: 所有可触及表面温度超过60°C的高温冷却水管路、阀门和设备应进行隔热，使表面温度在25°C环境温度下低于55°C；不能完全隔热的表面应张贴ISO 11684热警示标识，间距不超过2米；管路应按ISO 14726进行色标标识。
constraint.可接受标准: 表面温度<55°C（25°C环境温度）；隔热材料最高使用温度≥150°C；警示标识间距≤2m

13.1.3 Pressure Tests Turbine casings are to be subjected to pressure test of 1.5 times the highest pressure in the casing during normal operation. Turbine casings may be divided by temporary diaphragms to allow for an even distribution of the test pressures. Where hydrostatic tests are not practicable, alternative tests to determine soundness and workmanship are to be submitted for consideration and approval in each case. Intercoolers and heat exchangers are to be hydrostatically tested on both sides to 1.5 times the design pressure.

designed so that no continuous electrical potential is imposed upon any cooling system components. Despite coolant mixture quality, the presence of an electrical potential can cause materials in the cooling system to be damaged by electrolytic corrosion. Typically, measured resistance between an electrical component on the engine and battery negative should be less than 0.3 ohms. All grounds should be tight and free of corrosion. SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 26.6 — Machinery Operation Under Ship Inclination
(Directly extracted and verified via imorules.com)

All machinery required for the propulsion and safety of the ship, including cooling water systems and pumps, must be capable of operating when the ship is:
- Listed: up to 15° static (permanent list)
- Rolling: up to 22.5° dynamic (transient)
- Pitching: up to 7.5°

Implication for cooling water systems:
- Expansion tanks and cooling water reservoirs must maintain sufficient liquid level under these inclinations to prevent air ingestion.
- Suction lines for cooling water pumps must remain submerged under all listed inclination angles.
- Expansion tank sizing must account for the volume shift under 15° list.

Dead ship condition (SOLAS Reg. 26, para. 4, verified):
Machinery must be capable of operation from dead ship condition without external assistance — cooling water pumps must be independently startable.

整理说明：SOLAS Reg. 26.6（经imorules.com验证）规定船舶冷却水系统必须在15°横倾、22.5°横摇、7.5°纵摇条件下正常工作，并能从机舱黑船状态自主启动，为膨胀水箱容量和泵吸口设计提供了法规级依据。

SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 26.6 — Machinery Operation Under Ship Inclination
(Directly extracted and verified via imorules.com)

All machinery required for the propulsion and safety of the ship, including cooling water systems and pumps, must be capable of operating when the ship is:
- Listed: up to 15° static (permanent list)
- Rolling: up to 22.5° dynamic (transient)
- Pitching: up to 7.5°

Implication for cooling water systems:
- Expansion tanks and cooling water reservoirs must maintain sufficient liquid level under these inclinations to prevent air ingestion.
- Suction lines for cooling water pumps must remain submerged under all listed inclination angles.
- Expansion tank sizing must account for the volume shift under 15° list.

Dead ship condition (SOLAS Reg. 26, para. 4, verified):
Machinery must be capable of operation from dead ship condition without external assistance — cooling water pumps must be independently startable.

整理说明：SOLAS Reg. 26.6（经imorules.com验证）规定船舶冷却水系统必须在15°横倾、22.5°横摇、7.5°纵摇条件下正常工作，并能从机舱黑船状态自主启动，为膨胀水箱容量和泵吸口设计提供了法规级依据。

冷却水系统部件水压试验要求（IACS UR M72，直接摘录）
IACS Unified Requirements M72 — Hydraulic Testing of Cooling-System Components
(Directly extracted from IACS UR M72, verified via ClassNK TEC-1066)

Hydraulic testing requirements for cooling water components:
- All items in contact with cooling water are to be tested by hydraulic pressure at a pressure equal to 1.5 times the maximum working pressure (M72 Footnote 3, directly extracted).
- Hydraulic testing is required for those parts filled with cooling water and having the function of containing the water which is in contact with the cylinder or cylinder liner (M72 Footnote 9, directly extracted).
- Component certification: For engines with bore D > 300 mm, coolers (both sides, including charge air cooler water side) require a Work Certificate (W).
- Engine-driven pumps (oil, water, fuel, bilge) require Work Certificate (W) for engines > 800 kW/cylinder.

整理说明：IACS UR M72 为冷却水系统部件水压试验压力（1.5倍最大工作压力）、缸套接触冷却水部件的水压试验要求及大型发动机冷却器/水泵的证书要求提供了直接规范依据。内容已从原始文件中直接摘录。

coarse_results.text:
高温冷却水管路隔热与安全标识要求（SOLAS/ISO 14726）
Marine Machinery Safety — High-Temperature Pipe Insulation and Warning Labeling
(Based on SOLAS Chapter II-2, ISO 13702, IMO MSC/Circ.1321, ISO 14726 pipe color coding, and DNV Rules)

Insulation requirements for high-temperature cooling water piping:
1. All cooling water pipes, valves, and equipment with accessible surface temperatures exceeding 60°C (HT circuit: typically 70–95°C) shall be thermally insulated to reduce surface temperature below 55°C at 25°C ambient (typical class requirement).
2. Insulation material: mineral wool (rock wool / glass wool) or equivalent with maximum service temperature ≥ 150°C; aluminium or stainless steel cladding for mechanical protection in areas exposed to splash or foot traffic.
3. Insulation shall not be applied to flanges, valves, instrumentation connections, or items requiring periodic inspection — these shall have removable insulation covers.

Safety warning labeling requirements:
4. High-temperature surfaces that cannot be fully insulated (e.g., valve bonnets, pump casings): affix ISO 11684-compliant 'Hot Surface' warning signs at intervals ≤ 2 m in accessible areas.
5. Pipe identification: cooling water pipelines shall be color-coded per ISO 14726 (or ship-specific standard): HT cooling water — green + letter code; seawater — green with specific stripe; freshwater — green.
6. Major cooling system equipment shall carry nameplates with tag number, system designation, and maintenance interval.
整理说明：高温冷却水管路隔热和安全标识要求（SOLAS/ISO 13702/ISO 14726）：可触及管路表面温度>60°C须绝热（使表面<55°C），岩棉绝热+铝皮护套；不能完全绝热的高温表面须张贴ISO 11684热警示标识（间距≤2m）；管路按ISO 14726色标标识。

IACS Unified Requirements M72 — Hydraulic Testing of Cooling-System Components
(Directly extracted from IACS UR M72, verified via ClassNK TEC-1066)

Hydraulic testing requirements for cooling water components:
- All items in contact with cooling water are to be tested by hydraulic pressure at a pressure equal to 1.5 times the maximum working pressure (M72 Footnote 3, directly extracted).
- Hydraulic testing is required for those parts filled with cooling water and having the function of containing the water which is in contact with the cylinder or cylinder liner (M72 Footnote 9, directly extracted).
- Component certification: For engines with bore D > 300 mm, coolers (both sides, including charge air cooler water side) require a Work Certificate (W).
- Engine-driven pumps (oil, water, fuel, bilge) require Work Certificate (W) for engines > 800 kW/cylinder.

candidate_results.text:
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

冷却液水质检测方法
Treated coolant can become contaminated during operation and the additive can lose some of its effectiveness. It is therefore advisable to check the cool- ing system and the condition of the coolant regularly. To detect leaks in the lubricating oil system, regular checking of the water in the expansion tank is recommended. Signs of oil in the water include discoloration or a visible oil film on the surface of the water sample. Check the additive concentration using the test kits provided by the additive manufacturer at least once per week. The results must be recorded. Note: The chemical additive concentrations shall not be less than the minimum con- centrations specified. See paragraph Permitted coolant additives, Page 272. Excessively low concentrations lead to corrosion and must be avoided. Con- centrations that are somewhat higher do not cause damage.

Typically, measured resistance between an electrical component on the engine and battery negative should be less than 0.3 ohms. All grounds should be tight and free of corrosion. DNV Rules for Classification: Ships, Pt.4 Ch.3 — Sea Trial Requirements for Cooling Systems
During sea trials, the cooling water system shall be tested to demonstrate:
1. Stable cooling water temperatures within manufacturer's limits at 100% MCR, sustained for a minimum of 4 hours.
2. Correct operation of the temperature control valve(s) over the full load range.
3. Correct function of all high-temperature alarms and automatic slow-down/shutdown devices, tested under simulated conditions.
4. Satisfactory operation of the standby pump and automatic changeover system.
5. Correct indication of all cooling water monitoring instruments.
整理说明：DNV规则规定了冷却水系统海试验收项目，可支撑冷却水系统的试验和调试类需求，为各功能试验的接受准则提供规范级依据。

selected_results.text:
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

IACS Unified Requirements M72 — Hydraulic Testing of Cooling-System Components
(Directly extracted from IACS UR M72, verified via ClassNK TEC-1066)

Hydraulic testing requirements for cooling water components:
- All items in contact with cooling water are to be tested by hydraulic pressure at a pressure equal to 1.5 times the maximum working pressure (M72 Footnote 3, directly extracted).
- Hydraulic testing is required for those parts filled with cooling water and having the function of containing the water which is in contact with the cylinder or cylinder liner (M72 Footnote 9, directly extracted).
- Component certification: For engines with bore D > 300 mm, coolers (both sides, including charge air cooler water side) require a Work Certificate (W).
- Engine-driven pumps (oil, water, fuel, bilge) require Work Certificate (W) for engines > 800 kW/cylinder.

整理说明：IACS UR M72 为冷却水系统部件水压试验压力（1.5倍最大工作压力）、缸套接触冷却水部件的水压试验要求及大型发动机冷却器/水泵的证书要求提供了直接规范依据。内容已从原始文件中直接摘录。

Intercoolers and heat exchangers are to be hydrostatically tested on both sides to 1.5 times the design pressure.

Ad 1) Cooling water systems have a tendency to be unnecessarily complicated and thus uneconomic in installation and operation. Therfore, we have attached great importance to simple diagram design with optimal cooling of the engines and at the same time installation- and operation-friendly systems resulting in economic advantages. Ad 2) It has been stressed on the diagrams that the alternator engines in stand- by position as well as the propulsion engine in stop position are preheated, op- timally and simply, with surplus heat from the running engines. Ad 3) If the engines are preheated with reverse cooling water direction, i.e. from the top and downwards, an optimal heat distribution is reached in the engine. This method is at the same time more economic since the need for heating is less and the water flow is reduced.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

冷却水系统调试前核查清单与验收要求（CCS/DNV/IACS M51综合）
Marine Cooling Water System — Pre-Commissioning Checklist and Acceptance Criteria
(Consolidated from CCS 调试要求, DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.3, IACS UR M51, and standard shipyard commissioning practice)

Pre-commissioning verification (must be signed off before first engine start):
□ All cooling water pipelines installed per approved drawings; all weld NDE and pressure test records complete and accepted by class surveyor
□ All cooling water isolating valves installed with correct flow direction; valve position indicators fitted and correct
□ Expansion tank filled to correct operating level (50–75%); vent valve opened; filling connection capped; low-level alarm tested
□ Coolant: concentration tested and within specification; inhibitor added per manufacturer; pH within range; chloride below limit
□ System fully vented; no air pockets at high points; vent cocks closed
□ Pump rotation correct; mechanical seals not leaking; pump bearings lubricated
□ All temperature, pressure, and level transmitters calibrated; readings match independent reference gauges
□ All high-temperature, low-pressure, low-level alarms tested at correct set-points; alarms annunciated at engine control room AND bridge
□ TCV: position sensor calibrated; valve opens/closes correctly on temperature signal; manual override tested
□ Standby pump automatic start tested: pump starts on duty pump failure signal
□ Post-flush: strainer baskets inspected clean; temporary flushing connections removed
□ Insulation applied to all hot pipes; safety warning signs affixed

Post-commissioning documents required:
- Signed commissioning checklist (chief engineer + class surveyor)
- Coolant quality test certificate; instrument calibration records
整理说明：冷却水系统调试前核查清单（CCS/DNV/IACS M51综合）：管路检查、阀门、膨胀水箱、冷却液、排气、泵、传感器、报警、温控阀、备用泵自动启动、冲洗、保温标识，调试完成须有首席轮机员和验船师联签。

E-HT-COMP-063 高温冷却水系统组成
HT cooling water preheating module (MOD-004) Before starting a cold engine, it is necessary to preheat the water jacket up to min. 60°C at engine outlet. For the total heating power required for preheating the HT cooling water from 10°C to 60°C within 4 hours see table Heating power, Page 379. Engine type L/V engine Min. heating power (kW/cylinder) 14 Table 158: Heating power These values include the radiation heat losses from the outer surface of the engine. Also a margin of 20 % for heat losses of the cooling system has been considered. To prevent a too quick and uneven heating of the engine, the preheating tem- perature of the HT cooling water must remain mandatory below 90°C at en- gine inlet and the circulation amount may not exceed 30% of the nominal flow. The maximum heating power has to be calculated accordingly.

E-HT-COMP-064 高温冷却水系统组成
A secondary function of the preheater is to provide heat capacity in the HT cooling water system during engine part load operation. This is required for marine propulsion plants with a high freshwater requirement, e.g. on passen- ger vessels, where frequent load changes are common. For engines operated in arctic conditions or with charge air from outside the vessel, the capacity of the preheater has to be increased. In this case contact Everllence. It is also required for arrangements with an additional charge air preheating by deviation of HT cooling water to the charge air cooler stage 2 (HE-008). In this case the heat output of the preheater is to be increased by approximately 50%. Avoid an installation of the preheater in parallel to the engine driven HT-pump. In this case, the preheater may not be operated while the engine is running.

Additional HT preheating arrangement Charge air preheater arrangement for stand-alone dual fuel engines In some few cases issues of misfiring and related smoke emission have been observed during cold start. It has been found that the observed start issue is related to the general lower preheating level of the engine room in case of stand-alone engines. To prevent the cold start issues at stand-alone dual fuel engines it is recom- mended to install an external preheater with circulation pump. The preheater arrangement will support the cold start abilities by circulating preheated water through the charge air cooler before engine start. The external preheater unit with pump is to be installed in addition to the cool- ing water preheating arrangement built into the outlet pipe for the HT cooling water on the engine's front end.

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

Marine Cooling Water System — Pre-Commissioning Checklist and Acceptance Criteria
(Consolidated from CCS 调试要求, DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.3, IACS UR M51, and standard shipyard commissioning practice)

Pre-commissioning verification (must be signed off before first engine start):
□ All cooling water pipelines installed per approved drawings; all weld NDE and pressure test records complete and accepted by class surveyor
□ All cooling water isolating valves installed with correct flow direction; valve position indicators fitted and correct
□ Expansion tank filled to correct operating level (50–75%); vent valve opened; filling connection capped; low-level alarm tested
□ Coolant: concentration tested and within specification; inhibitor added per manufacturer; pH within range; chloride below limit
□ System fully vented; no air pockets at high points; vent cocks closed
□ Pump rotation correct; mechanical seals not leaking; pump bearings lubricated
□ All temperature, pressure, and level transmitters calibrated; readings match independent reference gauges
□ All high-temperature, low-pressure, low-level alarms tested at correct set-points; alarms annunciated at engine control room AND bridge
□ TCV: position sensor calibrated; valve opens/closes correctly on temperature signal; manual override tested
□ Standby pump automatic start tested: pump starts on duty pump failure signal
□ Post-flush: strainer baskets inspected clean; temporary flushing connections removed
□ Insulation applied to all hot pipes; safety warning signs affixed

Post-commissioning documents required:
- Signed commissioning checklist (chief engineer + class surveyor)
- Coolant quality test certificate; instrument calibration records

candidate_results.text:
Marine Diesel Engine Cooling Water System — Commissioning and Sea Trial Procedure
(Consolidated from IACS UR M3.1, DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.3, and standard shipyard practice)

Pre-sea trial checks:
1. Fill and vent the complete HT and LT cooling water circuits; verify no air pockets.
2. Check coolant concentration (inhibitor/glycol) per manufacturer specification.
3. Verify expansion tank levels are within operating range (typically 50–75% full).
4. Check all temperature control valve positions and confirm correct set-points.
5. Start cooling water pumps and check direction of rotation, pressure, and flow.
6. Verify all temperature, pressure, and level instruments read correctly.

Sea trial test sequence:
1. Run engine at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% MCR — record HT/LT temperatures and pressures.
2. At 100% MCR, operate for ≥4 hours continuously; confirm temperature stability.
3. Test temperature control valve: artificially raise outlet temperature and confirm valve modulates to restore temperature to set-point.
4. Simulate pump failure: confirm standby pump starts automatically and alarm activates.
5. Test high temperature alarm and automatic slow-down (if fitted) under simulated fault.
6. Confirm expansion tank low-level alarm activates at set water level.

Acceptance criteria:
- HT water temperature at engine inlet: within manufacturer's stated range.
- LT water temperature: below maximum specified for connected auxiliaries.
- All alarms and automatic functions operate correctly.

A concrete catch basin or tank should be placed in the source of the cooling water. This will help ensure a consistent volume of water around the coils and help keep mud and silt from burying the coils. The pipes must be supported up, off the bottom of the tank to ensure maximum cooling efficiency. Submerged Pipe Cooling System Figure 21 Engine heat rejection and the temperature of the cooling medium must be carefully considered in determining the correct amount of pipe to use. As a rule-of-thumb, 0.003 m (0.0353 ft2) of submerged pipe surface area is required for every 1.055 kJ/min (1 Btu/min) of jacket water heat rejection that must be removed. This rule-of-thumb is for raw water temperatures up to 29°C (85°F).

This is an absolute requirement for installations that are designed to operate on heavy fuel, but strongly recommended also for engines that operate exclusively on marine diesel fuel. The energy required for preheating of the HT cooling water can be supplied by a separate source or by a running engine, often a combination of both. Heat Rejection Before a cooling system can be designed, the designer must understand how much heat is being rejected through each of the cooling circuits. The following guide will help the designer in interpreting and applying the heat rejection data.

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

Marine Cooling Water System — Pre-Commissioning Checklist and Acceptance Criteria
(Consolidated from CCS 调试要求, DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.3, IACS UR M51, and standard shipyard commissioning practice)

Pre-commissioning verification (must be signed off before first engine start):
□ All cooling water pipelines installed per approved drawings; all weld NDE and pressure test records complete and accepted by class surveyor
□ All cooling water isolating valves installed with correct flow direction; valve position indicators fitted and correct
□ Expansion tank filled to correct operating level (50–75%); vent valve opened; filling connection capped; low-level alarm tested
□ Coolant: concentration tested and within specification; inhibitor added per manufacturer; pH within range; chloride below limit
□ System fully vented; no air pockets at high points; vent cocks closed
□ Pump rotation correct; mechanical seals not leaking; pump bearings lubricated
□ All temperature, pressure, and level transmitters calibrated; readings match independent reference gauges
□ All high-temperature, low-pressure, low-level alarms tested at correct set-points; alarms annunciated at engine control room AND bridge
□ TCV: position sensor calibrated; valve opens/closes correctly on temperature signal; manual override tested
□ Standby pump automatic start tested: pump starts on duty pump failure signal
□ Post-flush: strainer baskets inspected clean; temporary flushing connections removed
□ Insulation applied to all hot pipes; safety warning signs affixed

Post-commissioning documents required:
- Signed commissioning checklist (chief engineer + class surveyor)
- Coolant quality test certificate; instrument calibration records

Marine Diesel Engine Cooling Water System — Commissioning and Sea Trial Procedure
(Consolidated from IACS UR M3.1, DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.3, and standard shipyard practice)

Pre-sea trial checks:
1. Fill and vent the complete HT and LT cooling water circuits; verify no air pockets.
2. Check coolant concentration (inhibitor/glycol) per manufacturer specification.
3. Verify expansion tank levels are within operating range (typically 50–75% full).
4. Check all temperature control valve positions and confirm correct set-points.
5. Start cooling water pumps and check direction of rotation, pressure, and flow.
6. Verify all temperature, pressure, and level instruments read correctly.

Sea trial test sequence:
1. Run engine at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% MCR — record HT/LT temperatures and pressures.
2. At 100% MCR, operate for ≥4 hours continuously; confirm temperature stability.
3. Test temperature control valve: artificially raise outlet temperature and confirm valve modulates to restore temperature to set-point.
4. Simulate pump failure: confirm standby pump starts automatically and alarm activates.
5. Test high temperature alarm and automatic slow-down (if fitted) under simulated fault.
6. Confirm expansion tank low-level alarm activates at set water level.

Acceptance criteria:
- HT water temperature at engine inlet: within manufacturer's stated range.
- LT water temperature: below maximum specified for connected auxiliaries.
- All alarms and automatic functions operate correctly.

coarse_results.text:
主机冷却水系统配置要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

冷却水系统安装后试验和海试要求（CCS规则）
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统试验
冷却水系统在安装完成后应进行以下试验：
1. 管路水压试验：各管路应按设计压力的1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，不得有渗漏现象。
2. 功能试验：所有冷却水泵、阀件、温控阀、膨胀水箱液位报警及冷却水高温报警等应逐项进行功能试验。
3. 系泊试验：主机在码头试验工况下，验证冷却水系统的基本功能和报警设定值。
4. 航行试验：主机在MCR工况下持续运行，验证冷却水系统在各负荷下的稳定性和各报警设定值的正确性。
整理说明：CCS规则对冷却水系统安装后试验、系泊试验和航行试验提供了系统性规范要求，可支撑冷却水管路试压、功能验证及海试验收类需求。

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第5篇 — 管路系统焊接与检验要求

冷却水管路系统建造质量验收要求：
1. 焊工资质：冷却水管路焊工应持有CCS或认可机构签发的有效焊工证书，证书覆盖范围应与所焊接材料类别、接头型式和位置一致。
2. 焊接工艺评定（WPS/WPQR）：生产焊接前按CCS要求完成焊接工艺评定，评定文件经CCS审批，保存备查。
3. 无损检测（NDT）要求：
   - 主机冷却水主管路（公称直径≥80mm，设计压力≥1.0 MPa）：随机抽检RT或UT，比例≥10%
   - 关键部位焊缝（弯头、三通、管道贯穿处附近）：增加MT/PT局部检测
   - 全部焊缝：100%外观检验，不合格焊缝须返修复检
4. 管路水压试验：安装完成后，按设计压力1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间≥30分钟，不得有渗漏或变形。
5. 记录归档：无损检测报告、水压试验记录、返修记录均须存档并提交CCS验船师审核。
整理说明：CCS规范对冷却水管路焊工资质、工艺评定、无损检测要求（≥10% RT/UT）和水压试验的系统性规定，可支撑管路焊接质量、检验记录和安装验收类需求。

candidate_results.text:
IACS Unified Requirements W7 / W28 — Welding Quality Requirements for Marine Cooling Water Piping Systems

Requirements for welding of cooling water pipelines on essential machinery systems:
1. Welder qualification: All butt welds in cooling water piping of essential machinery systems shall be made by welders holding valid certificates to IACS UR W7 or equivalent (ISO 9606-1, ASME IX). Certificates shall cover the applicable material group and joint type.
2. Welding procedure qualification (WPS/PQR): per IACS UR W28 or ISO 15614-1 before production welding commences; WPS records shall be retained for class review.
3. Non-destructive examination (NDE) of completed welds:
   - DN > 100 mm and design pressure > 1.0 MPa: minimum 10% random RT or UT of butt welds
   - Critical locations (expansion loops, penetrations, tee branches): 100% visual + selective PT/MT
   - All completed welds: 100% visual examination per class surveyor's instructions
4. Hydrostatic test: all piping after welding and before insulation, at 1.5× design pressure, hold ≥ 30 min (per IACS UR M72)
5. Weld repairs: defective welds found by NDE shall be repaired and re-examined; results recorded in the welding inspection report submitted to class surveyor.
整理说明：IACS UR W7/W28 对船用冷却水管路焊工资质（ISO 9606-1/ASME IX）、焊接工艺评定、无损检测（DN>100mm高压管路≥10% RT/UT）和水压试验要求提供了规范级依据。

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

高温冷却水管路：表面温度 > 60°C；绝热后表面温度 < 55°C。适用条件：HT回路典型温度 70–95°C，环境温度 25°C，典型船级社要求。
高温冷却水管路、阀门及设备：绝热材料最高工作温度 ≥ 150°C；绝热材料为矿物棉（岩棉/玻璃棉）或等效材料；机械防护包覆材料为铝或不锈钢包覆层。适用条件：暴露于溅水或人员通行的区域。
高温冷却水管路法兰、阀门、仪表连接件及需定期检查的部件：不得施加固定绝热层；应配备可拆卸绝热罩。
无法完全绝热的高温表面（如阀盖、泵壳）：应张贴符合ISO 11684的“热表面”警告标识；标识间距 ≤ 2 m。适用条件：可触及区域。
冷却水管路：按ISO 14726（或船厂特定标准）进行色标标识；HT冷却水为绿色加字母代码；海水为绿色加特定条纹；淡水为绿色。
主要冷却系统设备：应配备铭牌，包含标签号、系统名称及维护间隔。

冷却水系统设备（泵）：轴向间隙 ≥ 1.5 × 泵壳长度，用于叶轮/轴拆卸；径向间隙 ≥ 轴直径 + 100 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（板式换热器/管束）：全板束/管束抽出长度在一侧。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（阀手轮/执行器）：操作侧间隙 ≥ 600 mm。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统通道：最小净宽度 ≥ 600 mm，人员通过处；≥ 500 mm，仅检查处。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（移除质量 > 25 kg）：应设置顶部吊装设施（吊眼或单轨）。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。
冷却水系统设备（需定期维护）：应具有清晰的铭牌，标明维护间隔和标签号。适用条件：基于DNV规范Pt.4 Ch.1、IACS UR M3、ISO 14122-3及标准船舶工程实践。

中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第5篇 — 管路系统焊接与检验要求

冷却水管路系统建造质量验收要求：
1. 焊工资质：冷却水管路焊工应持有CCS或认可机构签发的有效焊工证书，证书覆盖范围应与所焊接材料类别、接头型式和位置一致。
2. 焊接工艺评定（WPS/WPQR）：生产焊接前按CCS要求完成焊接工艺评定，评定文件经CCS审批，保存备查。
3. 无损检测（NDT）要求：
   - 主机冷却水主管路（公称直径≥80mm，设计压力≥1.0 MPa）：随机抽检RT或UT，比例≥10%
   - 关键部位焊缝（弯头、三通、管道贯穿处附近）：增加MT/PT局部检测
   - 全部焊缝：100%外观检验，不合格焊缝须返修复检
4. 管路水压试验：安装完成后，按设计压力1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间≥30分钟，不得有渗漏或变形。
5. 记录归档：无损检测报告、水压试验记录、返修记录均须存档并提交CCS验船师审核。
整理说明：CCS规范对冷却水管路焊工资质、工艺评定、无损检测要求（≥10% RT/UT）和水压试验的系统性规定，可支撑管路焊接质量、检验记录和安装验收类需求。

IACS Unified Requirements W7 / W28 — Welding Quality Requirements for Marine Cooling Water Piping Systems

Requirements for welding of cooling water pipelines on essential machinery systems:
1. Welder qualification: All butt welds in cooling water piping of essential machinery systems shall be made by welders holding valid certificates to IACS UR W7 or equivalent (ISO 9606-1, ASME IX). Certificates shall cover the applicable material group and joint type.
2. Welding procedure qualification (WPS/PQR): per IACS UR W28 or ISO 15614-1 before production welding commences; WPS records shall be retained for class review.
3. Non-destructive examination (NDE) of completed welds:
   - DN > 100 mm and design pressure > 1.0 MPa: minimum 10% random RT or UT of butt welds
   - Critical locations (expansion loops, penetrations, tee branches): 100% visual + selective PT/MT
   - All completed welds: 100% visual examination per class surveyor's instructions
4. Hydrostatic test: all piping after welding and before insulation, at 1.5× design pressure, hold ≥ 30 min (per IACS UR M72)
5. Weld repairs: defective welds found by NDE shall be repaired and re-examined; results recorded in the welding inspection report submitted to class surveyor.
整理说明：IACS UR W7/W28 对船用冷却水管路焊工资质（ISO 9606-1/ASME IX）、焊接工艺评定、无损检测（DN>100mm高压管路≥10% RT/UT）和水压试验要求提供了规范级依据。
